thoughts.sr: Zvanični okvir je označen kao 06:00 UTC, dok je procenjeno stvarno vreme 04:00, pa je poređenje maksimuma vremenski pomereno. Najnovije vrednosti pokazuju PM10 na 28, NO2 na 38 i PM2.5 na 20 µg/m³, ali zapis ima 0 dana osnovice i ne podržava tvrdnje da su ovi nivoi porasli ili da su neuobičajeni. [F3][F4][F6][F8][F48]
thoughts.en: The official frame is labelled 06:00 UTC while the estimated true time is 04:00, so the maxima comparison is temporally displaced [F3]. The latest values show PM10 at 28, NO2 at 38, and PM2.5 at 20 µg/m³ [F4][F6][F8], but the record has 0 days of baseline and cannot support claims that these levels rose or are unusual [F48].
hypotheses: The apparent pollutant changes may reflect a labelling or alignment artifact rather than a fresh city-wide trend, because the source’s labelled hour and estimated true UTC differ [F3][F5][F7][F9].
questions: Can the next SEPA record provide a correctly aligned UTC timestamp and enough historical baseline to test whether the station maxima are genuinely changing? [F3][F48]
hypotheses_sr: Prividne promene zagađivača mogu biti posledica greške u označavanju ili usklađivanju, a ne svežeg trenda na nivou grada, jer se označeni sat izvora i procenjeni stvarni UTC razlikuju [F3][F5][F7][F9].
questions_sr: Može li sledeći SEPA zapis da obezbedi ispravno usklađenu UTC vremensku oznaku i dovoljnu istorijsku osnovicu za proveru da li se maksimumi na stanicama zaista menjaju? [F3][F48]
thoughts.next_check: Verify SEPA timestamp alignment and accumulate the required historical baseline before interpreting changes.

thoughts.sr: Najnoviji označeni sat nije čist vremenski pokazatelj: SEPA ga označava kao 06:00 UTC, dok je procenjeno stvarno UTC vreme 04:00. U tom okviru, maksimumi PM10 i PM2.5 su opali, dok je NO2 porastao, a noviji tok građanskih senzora je primljen skorije. [F3][F5][F7][F9][F10]
thoughts.en: The latest labelled hour is not a clean clock: SEPA labels it 06:00 UTC while the estimated true UTC is 04:00 [F3]. Within that frame, PM10 and PM2.5 maxima fell while NO2 rose [F5][F7][F9], and the newer citizen stream has been received more recently [F10].
hypotheses: The opposing pollutant movements may reflect different local sources rather than one city-wide change, since the maxima are observed across separate station networks and locations [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Will the next SEPA frame preserve the opposing PM10, NO2, and PM2.5 directions after the timestamp issue is corrected [F3][F5][F7][F9]?
Does the recent citizen stream show a comparable spatial pattern to the official stations [F10]?
Can the source clock mapping be verified against the next labelled hour [F3]?
hypotheses_sr: Suprotna kretanja zagađivača mogu odražavati različite lokalne izvore, a ne jednu promenu u celom gradu, pošto su maksimumi zabeleženi na odvojenim mrežama i lokacijama [F4][F6][F8].
questions_sr: Da li će sledeći SEPA okvir zadržati suprotne smerove PM10, NO2 i PM2.5 nakon ispravke vremenske oznake [F3][F5][F7][F9]?
Da li noviji tok građanskih senzora pokazuje uporediv prostorni obrazac sa zvaničnim stanicama [F10]?
Može li se mapiranje sata izvora proveriti u odnosu na sledeći označeni sat [F3]?
thoughts.next_check: Verify the SEPA timestamp mapping and compare the next complete labelled hour with the current maxima movements [F3][F5][F7][F9].

thoughts.sr: Vidim da je Topčiderska zvezda na zabeleženim minimumima za PM10, 13 µg/m³, i PM2.5, 11 µg/m³, dok su njihovi maksimumi na Ada petlja, odnosno Borča. Nasuprot tome, NO2 dostiže zabeleženi maksimum od 38 µg/m³ na Bulevar despota Stefana, pri čemu je zvanični tok stigao pre 63 min, a građanski pre 18 min. [F4][F8][F2][F6][F10]
thoughts.en: I see Topčiderska zvezda at the recorded minima for PM10, 13 µg/m³, and PM2.5, 11 µg/m³, while their maxima occupy Ada petlja and Borča respectively [F4][F8]. NO2 instead reaches its recorded maximum of 38 µg/m³ at Bulevar despota Stefana, as the official stream arrived 63 min ago and the citizen stream 18 min ago [F2][F6][F10].
hypotheses: The separation of the PM10, PM2.5, and NO2 maxima may indicate pollutant-specific spatial patterns rather than a shared citywide maximum [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Do the maxima remain separated across Ada petlja, Bulevar despota Stefana, and Borča in the next comparable frame [F4][F6][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Razdvojenost maksimuma PM10, PM2.5 i NO2 može ukazivati na prostorne obrasce specifične za svaku zagađujuću materiju, a ne na zajednički maksimum širom grada.
questions_sr: Da li maksimumi ostaju razdvojeni između Ada petlja, Bulevar despota Stefana i Borča u sledećem uporedivom prikazu?
thoughts.next_check: Compare station-level PM10, NO2, and PM2.5 values in the next comparable SEPA frame, while accounting for the source’s time-label displacement [F3][F4][F6][F8].

thoughts.sr: Trenutno zvanično polje protivreči ranijim minimumima i maksimumima: PM10 se kreće od 13 na Topčiderskoj zvezdi do 42 na Adi petlji, dok se PM2.5 kreće od 12 u Vračar Domu zdravlja do 30 na Adi petlji. Prividni porast je samo poređenje označeno vremenom izvora, a ne trend po lokalnom vremenu, i zapis izričito nema osnovu za tvrdnju da je to neuobičajeno visoko. [F4][F8][F5][F48]
thoughts.en: The current official field contradicts the earlier minima and maxima: PM10 spans 13 at Topčiderska zvezda to 42 at Ada petlja, while PM2.5 spans 12 at Vračar Dom zdravlja to 30 at Ada petlja [F4][F8]. The apparent rise is only a source-labelled comparison, not a local-time trend, and the record explicitly lacks a baseline for calling it unusually high [F5][F48].
hypotheses: The shared spatial pattern may reflect a source-label artefact rather than a citywide change: both PM10 and PM2.5 place their maxima at Ada petlja in the latest labelled hour [F4][F8], but the record cannot establish what is usual at this hour [F48].
questions: What do the next official receptions show for PM10 and PM2.5, and do their station maxima remain at Ada petlja?
hypotheses_sr: Zajednički prostorni obrazac može odražavati artefakt oznake izvora, a ne promenu u celom gradu: i PM10 i PM2.5 imaju maksimum na Adi petlji u poslednjem označenom satu [F4][F8], ali zapis ne može utvrditi šta je uobičajeno u ovom satu [F48].
questions_sr: Šta pokazuju sledeći zvanični prijemi za PM10 i PM2.5 i da li njihovi maksimumi po stanicama ostaju na Adi petlji?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next SEPA labelled hour with the current station ranges, without treating source labels as true local time.

thoughts.sr: Sada vidim maksimume čestica na različitim stanicama: PM10 na stanici Ada petlja, 39 µg/m³, i PM2.5 u Leštanima, 26 µg/m³, umesto zajedničke lokacije u ranijem Skeptikovom prikazu. Vidim i maksimum NO2 na drugom mestu, na Bulevaru despota Stefana, 68 µg/m³; sami ovi ekstremi ne mogu pokazati da li se prostorna razdvojenost održava. [F4][F8][F6]
thoughts.en: I now see the particulate maxima at different stations: PM10 at Ada petlja, 39 µg/m³, and PM2.5 at Leštane, 26 µg/m³, rather than the shared location in Skeptic's earlier frame [F4][F8]. I also see the NO2 maximum elsewhere, at Bulevar despota Stefana, 68 µg/m³; these extrema alone cannot show whether the spatial separation persists [F6].
hypotheses: The separated maxima may reflect pollutant-specific spatial patterns rather than a shared hotspot, but I need station-by-station comparisons to test that possibility [F4][F8][F6].
questions: Do Ada petlja, Leštane and Bulevar despota Stefana retain these distinct pollutant maxima in subsequent comparable observations [F4][F8][F6]?
hypotheses_sr: Razdvojeni maksimumi mogu odražavati prostorne obrasce specifične za pojedinačne zagađujuće materije, a ne zajedničko žarište, ali potrebna su mi poređenja po stanicama da proverim tu mogućnost [F4][F8][F6].
questions_sr: Da li Ada petlja, Leštane i Bulevar despota Stefana zadržavaju ove različite maksimume zagađujućih materija u narednim uporedivim posmatranjima [F4][F8][F6]?

Poređenje sati podržava pad PM10 i PM2.5, ali rast NO2; ipak, oznaka izvora 08:00 UTC nije u skladu sa procenjenim stvarnim UTC vremenom 06:00, pa tumačenje sata koje je dao Connector nije pouzdano. [F4][F6][F8][F5][F7][F9][F3]
thoughts.en: The station maxima are spatially separated in the latest frame: PM10 is highest at Ada petlja [F4], NO2 at Bulevar despota Stefana [F6], and PM2.5 at Leštane [F8]. The hour comparison supports a fall in PM10 and PM2.5 but a rise in NO2 [F5][F7][F9]; however, the source’s 08:00 UTC label conflicts with the estimated true UTC of 06:00 [F3], so the Connector’s clock interpretation is not secure.
hypotheses: The differing station maxima may reflect pollutant-specific spatial structure rather than one shared city-wide plume [F4][F6][F8].

Prividne promene između označenih sati mogu biti stvarne, ali njihovo vremensko značenje ostaje neizvesno jer se oznaka izvora i procenjeno stvarno UTC vreme ne slažu [F3][F5][F7][F9].

Across the labelled hours, both particulate maxima declined as the NO2 maximum increased, but the source’s label offset keeps their relation to the present hour uncertain [F3][F5][F7][F9].
hypotheses: The differing peak stations may mark separate local influences rather than one citywide plume; compare the next labelled hour across the same stations [F4][F6][F8].

thoughts.sr: Tvrdnja o zajedničkoj lokaciji čestica već je zastarela: PM10 dostiže maksimum kod Omladinskih brigada sa 92 µg/m³, dok PM2.5 dostiže maksimum u Mirijevu sa 32 µg/m³. Connectorovih 49 µg/m³ jeste prethodni maksimum NO2, a ne trenutnih 42 µg/m³ kod Franše d’Eperea; pomak oznake i odsustvo referentnog perioda i dalje onemogućavaju tvrdnje o sadašnjem satu ili o tome šta je visoko. [F4][F8][F3][F7][F48]
thoughts.en: The claimed particulate co-location is already stale: PM10 peaks at Omladinskih brigada at 92 µg/m³, while PM2.5 peaks at Mirijevo at 32 µg/m³ [F4][F8]. Connector’s 49 µg/m³ is the prior NO2 maximum, not the current 42 µg/m³ at Franše d’Epere; the label offset and absent baseline still block claims about the present hour or what is high [F3][F7][F48].
hypotheses: The divergence between the PM10 and PM2.5 maxima may reflect a station-specific spatial pattern rather than a citywide particulate shift [F4][F8].
questions: Does the next labelled hour preserve the separation between Omladinskih brigada and Mirijevo [F4][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Razdvajanje maksimuma PM10 i PM2.5 možda odražava prostorni obrazac specifičan za stanice, a ne pomeranje čestica na nivou celog grada [F4][F8].
questions_sr: Da li sledeći označeni sat zadržava razdvajanje između Omladinskih brigada i Mirijeva [F4][F8]?

Između dva označena sata, maksimumi PM10 i PM2.5 pomerili su se naviše, dok se NO2 pomerio naniže, ali pomak oznake sprečava da ovo opisuje sadašnji sat. [F4][F6][F8][F3][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: The labelled maxima are separated: PM10 is at Omladinskih brigada, PM2.5 at Mirijevo, and NO2 at Franše d’Epere [F4][F6][F8]. Between the two labelled hours, the PM10 and PM2.5 maxima moved upward while NO2 moved downward, but the label offset keeps this from describing the present hour [F3][F5][F7][F9].
hypotheses: The distinct PM10, PM2.5, and NO2 maximum locations may reflect separate local influences rather than one shared spatial pattern [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Can the next SEPA reception preserve the separation among the labelled maxima after the source-time offset is accounted for [F2][F3][F4][F6][F8]?

thoughts.sr: Polje je postalo krupnočestično: maksimum PM10 za označeni čas je 99 µg/m³ na Omladinskih brigada, a minimum 14 µg/m³ na Krnjači, stanici oko koje po modelu živi oko 17 hiljada ljudi. Protiv Observera i Skeptika zajedno, PM10 i PM2.5 se nisu kretali zajedno — PM10 je porastao sa 88 na 99, a NO2 sa 35 na 43, dok je PM2.5 pao sa 34 na 25 µg/m³ između dva označena časa, i sama organela je taj pad ocenila kao najiznenađujući od tri, sa 3/5. Maksimum NO2 je na Pančevo Cara Dušana, van grada o kome su se ostala dva sporila, a pomeraj oznake vremena od dva časa plus prazna osnovna linija i dalje zabranjuju da se bilo šta od toga nazove visokim. [F4][F45][F5][F7][F9][F51][F6][F3][F47]
thoughts.en: The field has turned coarse-particulate: PM10's labelled-hour maximum is 99 µg/m³ at Omladinskih brigada and its minimum 14 µg/m³ at Krnjača [F4], a station around which about 17 thousand people are modelled to live [F45]. Against Observer and Skeptic both, PM10 and PM2.5 did not move together — PM10 climbed from 88 to 99 and NO2 from 35 to 43, while PM2.5 fell from 34 to 25 µg/m³ between the two labelled hours [F5][F7][F9], and the organelle itself found that fall the most surprising of the three at 3/5 [F51]. The NO2 maximum sits at Pančevo Cara Dušana [F6], outside the city the other two were arguing about, and the two-hour label offset [F3] plus the empty baseline [F47] still forbid calling any of it high.
hypotheses: PM10 rising while PM2.5 falls between the labelled hours [F5][F9] would fit a coarse-dominated source — road or construction dust rather than combustion; the fine fraction would then not follow the coarse peak at Omladinskih brigada [F4][F8].

That Omladinskih brigada holds both the PM10 maximum of 99 and the PM2.5 maximum of 25 µg/m³ [F4][F8] while Krnjača holds the PM10 minimum of 14 and the NO2 minimum of 7 µg/m³ [F4][F6] suggests a stable station-level gradient across the network rather than an hour-specific event.

The NO2 maximum at Pančevo Cara Dušana at 43 µg/m³ [F6] belonging to a different urban area than the particulate maxima [F4][F8] would mean the nitrogen dioxide rise from 35 to 43 [F7] is driven outside Belgrade's own instruments.

Four sources reporting at the same 100-minute staleness — SEPA, Sensor.Community, Parking Servis, RHMZ Košutnjak, METAR [F2][F10][F11][F34][F35] — points at one collection cycle, not five independent silences; the 99-minute DanubeHIS reception [F42] is the only offset one.
questions: Does the PM10 maximum of 99 µg/m³ at Omladinskih brigada [F4] come from one instrument among the 32 [F2], and does that instrument also carry the PM2.5 maximum of 25 [F8]?
Why does SEPA label local time as Z, putting its last labelled hour at 14:00 UTC when our estimate of true UTC is 12:00 [F3]?
Is Pančevo Cara Dušana [F6][F46] inside the 31-station PM10 comparison [F4] as well, and what is its own PM10 value there?
How many of the 243 Parking Servis values across 27 locations [F11] changed at all in the window, given that only Parkiralište "VMA" is reported as moving from 157 to 423 [F12]?
hypotheses_sr: To što PM10 raste dok PM2.5 pada između označenih časova odgovaralo bi izvoru u kome preovlađuje krupna frakcija — prašini sa puta ili sa gradilišta, a ne sagorevanju; fina frakcija tada ne bi pratila krupni vrh na Omladinskih brigada.

To što Omladinskih brigada drži i maksimum PM10 od 99 i maksimum PM2.5 od 25 µg/m³, dok Krnjača drži minimum PM10 od 14 i minimum NO2 od 7 µg/m³, sugeriše stabilan gradijent na nivou stanica kroz mrežu, a ne događaj vezan za jedan čas.
To što maksimum NO2 na Pančevo Cara Dušana od 43 µg/m³ pripada drugom gradskom području nego maksimumi čestica značilo bi da je porast azot-dioksida sa 35 na 43 pokrenut van beogradskih instrumenata.

Četiri izvora koja prijavljuju istu zastarelost od 100 minuta — SEPA, Sensor.Community, Parking Servis, RHMZ Košutnjak, METAR — upućuju na jedan ciklus prikupljanja, a ne na pet nezavisnih tišina; prijem DanubeHIS od 99 minuta je jedini pomeren.
questions_sr: Da li maksimum PM10 od 99 µg/m³ na Omladinskih brigada dolazi sa jednog instrumenta među 32, i da li taj isti instrument nosi i maksimum PM2.5 od 25?
Zašto SEPA označava lokalno vreme kao Z, stavljajući svoj poslednji označeni čas na 14:00 UTC, dok je naša procena pravog UTC 12:00?
Da li je Pančevo Cara Dušana i unutar poređenja PM10 na 31 stanici, i kolika je njegova sopstvena vrednost PM10 tamo?
Koliko se od 243 vrednosti Parking Servisa na 27 lokacija uopšte promenilo u tom intervalu, s obzirom na to da se samo za Parkiralište "VMA" prijavljuje kretanje sa 157 na 423?
thoughts.next_check: Whether the next SEPA labelled hour continues the divergence — coarse PM10 up from 99 while PM2.5 stays below its earlier 34 µg/m³ [F4][F8][F9] — and whether the PM10 maximum stays at Omladinskih brigada [F4] or moves to another of the 31 stations.

thoughts.sr: Maksimumi koje su naveli Connector i Skeptic su se pomerili: maksimum za PM10 je sada 65 µg/m³ u Obrenovac Centru nakon prelaska sa 53 µg/m³, dok PM2.5 dostiže vrh sa 52 µg/m³ na stanici Zemun TB nakon prelaska sa 40 µg/m³. U međuvremenu, NO2 je dostigao 72 µg/m³ na Mostaru nakon 55 µg/m³, što pokazuje da su se svi maksimumi izmestili sa svojih ranijih lokacija. Na dnu opsega čestica, Topčiderska zvezda je zabeležila najniže vrednosti za PM10 od 15 µg/m³ i PM2.5 od 13 µg/m³. [F4][F5][F8][F9][F6][F7]
thoughts.en: The peaks cited by Connector and Skeptic have shifted: the maximum for PM10 is now 65 µg/m³ at Obrenovac Centar [F4] after moving from 53 µg/m³ [F5], while PM2.5 peaks at 52 µg/m³ at Zemun TB [F8] after moving from 40 µg/m³ [F9]. Meanwhile, NO2 reached 72 µg/m³ at Mostar [F6] after standing at 55 µg/m³ [F7], showing that all maxima shifted away from earlier locations. At the bottom of the particulate range, Topčiderska zvezda registered the lowest values for both PM10 at 15 µg/m³ [F4] and PM2.5 at 13 µg/m³ [F8].
hypotheses: The co-location of particulate minima at Topčiderska zvezda [F4][F8] suggests a localized sheltered pocket contrasting with peripheral peaks.

The divergence of maxima across distant stations—Obrenovac Centar for PM10 [F4], Zemun TB for PM2.5 [F8], and Mostar for NO2 [F6]—points to localized emission sources rather than a uniform citywide basin effect.
questions: Will the next SEPA hour show whether the peak at Obrenovac Centar [F4] spreads toward central stations or remains confined to the periphery?
Does the low particulate reading at Topčiderska zvezda [F4][F8] persist across consecutive reporting cycles?
hypotheses_sr: Zajednička lokacija minimuma čestica na stanici Topčiderska zvezda [F4][F8] ukazuje na lokalizovan zaštićen džep u poređenju sa perifernim vrhovima.

Divergencija maksimuma po udaljenim stanicama—Obrenovac Centar za PM10 [F4], Zemun TB za PM2.5 [F8] i Mostar za NO2 [F6]—ukazuje na lokalizovane izvore emisije pre nego na ujednačen efekat gradske kotline.
questions_sr: Da li će sledeći SEPA sat pokazati da li se vrh u Obrenovac Centru [F4] širi ka centralnim stanicama ili ostaje ograničen na periferiju?
Da li niska očitavanja čestica na Topčiderskoj zvezdi [F4][F8] opstaju kroz uzastopne cikluse izveštavanja?
thoughts.next_check: The next SEPA transmission [F2] for spatial shifts in particulate maxima between Obrenovac Centar [F4] and Zemun TB [F8].

thoughts.sr: SEPA i Sensor.Community su oba zabeležili poslednji prijem pre 100 min, dok je Parking servis takođe stigao pre 100 min sa 189 vrednosti na 27 lokacija, ali bez ikakvog vremena samog merenja. Unutar tog prozora prijema, prikazana slobodna mesta u Garaži "Obilićev venac" pomerila su se sa 2 na 227, uz 138 naslova Tanjug Belgrade-a i 51 naslov Danasa. [F2][F10][F11][F12][F13][F14]
thoughts.en: SEPA and Sensor.Community both recorded their latest reception 100 min ago [F2][F10], while Parking Servis also arrived 100 min ago with 189 values across 27 locations but without any timestamp on the measurement itself [F11]. Within that reporting window, displayed free spaces at Garaža "Obilićev venac" shifted from 2 to 227 [F12], alongside 138 headlines from Tanjug Belgrade [F13] and 51 headlines from Danas [F14].
hypotheses: The shift from 2 to 227 displayed free spaces at Garaža "Obilićev venac" reflects vehicle departures in the central core during the unmeasured reception window [F11][F12].

The concurrent 100 min delay across SEPA, Sensor.Community, and Parking Servis suggests an acquisition cadence alignment rather than simultaneous sensor inactivity across 32 official air stations, 47 citizen instruments, and 27 parking locations [F2][F10][F11].
questions: Will the next reception cycle update the unmeasured timestamps for the 189 Parking Servis values [F11]?
Did the 138 headlines from Tanjug Belgrade report any localized transit incidents corresponding to the parking shift at Obilićev venac [F12][F13]?
hypotheses_sr: Pomeranje sa 2 na 227 prikazanih slobodnih mesta u Garaži "Obilićev venac" odražava odlaske vozila u centralnom jezgru tokom neizmerenog prozora prijema [F11][F12].

Istovremeno kašnjenje od 100 min kod SEPA, Sensor.Community i Parking servisa sugeriše usklađenost ciklusa prikupljanja pre nego istovremenu neaktivnost senzora na 32 zvanične stanice za kvalitet vazduha, 47 građanskih instrumenata i 27 parking lokacija [F2][F10][F11].
questions_sr: Da li će sledeći ciklus prijema ažurirati neizmerena vremenska obeležja za 189 vrednosti Parking servisa [F11]?
Da li je 138 naslova Tanjug Belgrade-a izvestilo o bilo kakvim lokalizovanim saobraćajnim incidentima koji odgovaraju promeni na parkingu kod Obilićevog venca [F12][F13]?
thoughts.next_check: Check whether the next reception from Parking Servis arrives with age data or remains unmeasured [F11].

Istovremeno, SEPA sa 1441 vrednošću i Sensor.Community sa 2493 vrednosti stigli su pre 31 min, uz pristigle naslove iz Tanjug Belgrade, Danas, Studio B i Beta. [F11][F12][F2][F10][F13][F14][F15][F16]
thoughts.en: While Parking Servis reported 216 values across 27 locations without measurement timestamps [F11], displayed free spaces at Garaža "Obilićev venac" shifted from 2 to 343 between the first and last reception [F12]. Concurrently, both SEPA with 1441 values [F2] and Sensor.Community with 2493 values [F10] refreshed 31 min ago, alongside incoming headlines from Tanjug Belgrade [F13], Danas [F14], Studio B [F15], and Beta [F16].
hypotheses: The jump from 2 to 343 displayed spaces at Garaža "Obilićev venac" reflects batch clearing or display reset rather than actual vehicle flow [F11, F12].
Sensor.Community's 47 instruments [F10] and SEPA's 32 instruments [F2] capture concurrent midnight atmospheric dispersion across citizen and official grids.
questions: Does the shift from 2 to 343 at Garaža "Obilićev venac" correspond to an internal data reset interval [F11, F12]?
Will Tanjug Belgrade [F13] or Beta [F16] report any municipal disruptions related to the traffic infrastructure?
hypotheses_sr: Skok sa 2 na 343 prikazana mesta u Garaži "Obilićev venac" odražava grupno resetovanje ili ažuriranje prikaza pre nego stvaran protok vozila [F11, F12].
Sensor.Community sa 47 instrumenata [F10] i SEPA sa 32 instrumenta [F2] beleže istovremenu ponoćnu atmosfersku disperziju preko građanske i zvanične mreže.
questions_sr: Da li pomak sa 2 na 343 u Garaži "Obilićev venac" odgovara intervalu internog resetovanja podataka [F11, F12]?
Da li će Tanjug Belgrade [F13] ili Beta [F16] izvestiti o komunalnim poremećajima vezanim za saobraćajnu infrastrukturu?

thoughts.sr: Connector i Observer su se oslanjali na ranije brojeve o parkiranju, dok svež zapis pokazuje da su se prikazana slobodna mesta u Garaži "Obilićev venac" pomerila sa 0 na 355 kroz 216 vrednosti sa 27 lokacija bez ikakvog vremenskog žiga merenja. Pored toga, Sensor.Community i Parking Servis su oba pristigla pre 4 min, dok je SEPA pristigla pre 59 min, ostavljajući svaku pretpostavljenu sinhronost između građanskih senzora i zvaničnih stanica bez dokaza. [F12][F11][F10][F2]
thoughts.en: Connector and Observer relied on earlier parking figures, whereas the fresh record shows displayed free spaces at Garaža "Obilićev venac" moved from 0 to 355 [F12] across 216 values from 27 locations without any measurement timestamp [F11]. Furthermore, Sensor.Community and Parking Servis both arrived 4 min ago [F10] [F11], while SEPA arrived 59 min ago [F2], leaving any assumed synchrony between citizen monitors and official stations without evidence.
hypotheses: The jump from 0 to 355 displayed free spaces at Garaža "Obilićev venac" represents a system reset or reporting artifact rather than true vehicle departures given the absence of measurement timestamps across the 216 values [F11] [F12].
questions: Does Parking Servis supply true sensor acquisition timestamps for the 27 locations rather than reception times [F11]?
hypotheses_sr: Skok sa 0 na 355 prikazanih slobodnih mesta u Garaži "Obilićev venac" predstavlja resetovanje sistema ili artefakt izveštavanja pre nego stvarne odlaske vozila s obzirom na odsustvo vremenskih žigova merenja kroz 216 vrednosti [F11] [F12].
questions_sr: Da li Parking Servis obezbeđuje stvarne vremenske žigove akvizicije senzora za 27 lokacija umesto vremena prijema [F11]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next arrival from Parking Servis to see if the 355 displayed spaces at Garaža "Obilićev venac" remain stable [F11] [F12].

thoughts.sr: SEPA sopstveni prijem sada kasni 71 minut, dok su Sensor.Community i Parking Servis oba osvežena pre 16 minuta, što oštrije ocrtava nesinhronizovanost između zvaničnih i građanskih tokova na koju je Skeptic ukazao. Skok kod Parking Servisa na garaži "Obilićev venac", sa 0 na 355 slobodnih mesta, nema sopstvenu oznaku vremena, pa to čitam kao promenu kroz ceo prozor, a ne u jednom trenutku. Tanjugov naslov o uništavanju bombe na Paliluli sutra imenuje mesto, ali bez potvrđene veze s bilo kojim instrumentom koji pratim, a vremenske vesti Danasa, Studija B i Bete ostaju izvan te ograde. [F2][F10][F11][F12][F13][F14][F15][F16]
thoughts.en: SEPA's own reception now lags 71 minutes [F2], while Sensor.Community and Parking Servis both refreshed 16 minutes ago [F10][F11], sharpening the desynchrony between official and citizen streams that Skeptic raised. The Parking Servis swing at Garaža "Obilićev venac", 0 to 355 free spaces [F12], carries no timestamp of its own, so I read it as a change spread across the whole window rather than one moment. Tanjug's bomb-disposal headline for Palilula tomorrow [F13] names a place but not a confirmed link to any instrument I watch, and the weather headlines from Danas, Studio B and Beta [F14][F15][F16] stay outside that same fence.
hypotheses: The 71-minute gap since SEPA's last reception [F2] may simply reflect its reporting cadence rather than an outage, given Sensor.Community and Parking Servis both reported 16 minutes ago [F10][F11].

The free-space swing from 0 to 355 at Garaža "Obilićev venac" [F12] likely spans multiple vehicle turnovers across the whole window rather than one event, since Parking Servis carries no measurement timestamp [F11].
Tanjug's bomb-disposal notice for Palilula tomorrow [F13] and the City's transport listing could eventually describe the same closure, but geographic scope is unconfirmed [F13].
questions: Will SEPA's next reception restore the roughly 16-minute cadence seen in Sensor.Community and Parking Servis [F10][F11], or does the 71-minute gap [F2] persist?
Does the Garaža "Obilićev venac" swing [F12] reflect a real capacity change or an artifact of two readings with no shared clock?
hypotheses_sr: Razlika od 71 minut od poslednjeg SEPA prijema [F2] možda samo odražava njen uobičajeni ritam izveštavanja, a ne prekid, pošto su Sensor.Community i Parking Servis oba javili pre 16 minuta [F10][F11].
Skok slobodnih mesta sa 0 na 355 na garaži "Obilićev venac" [F12] verovatno obuhvata više smena vozila kroz ceo prozor, a ne jedan događaj, jer Parking Servis nema oznaku vremena merenja [F11].
Tanjugovo obaveštenje o uništavanju bombe na Paliluli sutra [F13] i spisak Gradskog saobraćaja mogli bi jednog dana opisivati isti događaj, ali geografski obuhvat nije potvrđen [F13].
questions_sr: Da li će sledeći SEPA prijem vratiti ritam od oko 16 minuta viđen kod Sensor.Community i Parking Servisa [F10][F11], ili će razlika od 71 minut [F2] potrajati?
Da li skok na garaži "Obilićev venac" [F12] odražava stvarnu promenu kapaciteta ili je artefakt dva očitavanja bez zajedničkog časovnika?
thoughts.next_check: Watch whether SEPA's next reception closes the 71-minute gap [F2].

hypotheses: The simultaneous decrease in peak values across PM10 [F5], PM2.5 [F9], and NO2 [F7] between 02:00 and 03:00 reflects shared atmospheric dispersion rather than localized source changes.

questions_sr: Da li će 2437 vrednosti sa Sensor.Community [F10] pokazati odgovarajući pad očitanih čestica na građanskim stanicama?
